name: Mitsumine Izumi
source:
The arrogant and headstrong leader of the White Lily Society, a well respected society of girls on campus. She and the other girls of the White Lily Society are teased for never having gotten pregnant prompting her to ask [url=https://vndb.org/c45063]Hiroki[/url] for help.

Despite being raped by Hiroki she's more concerned with her image than punishing him for it.
